Second: also fraud.

Third: impersonation of officials to obtain goods, also fraud. Could also be "伪造、变造居民身份证" no. "冒充工作人员" maybe "冒充国家机关工作人员诈骗罪" which is a specific type of fraud: "冒充国家机关工作人员诈骗罪". Usually we list "诈骗". So answer: [罪名]诈骗<eoa>. JSON format.
